concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-unified-commerce-pay-by-link-create-payment-links-api]] — 2026-09-15-captured Pay by Link API guide for creating/sending links, webhook and link-status checks, reuse, tokenization, method data, forced expiry and customization; source preserves expiry and BNPL cross-page qualifications.
warnings: POST link creation and GET link status are not payment authorization; await AUTHORISATION webhook and apply conditional manual capture separately.
PATCH status=expired changes link lifecycle and expiresAt; three-month detail retention is not link validity.
The related creation overview adds 70-day/five-failure limits not stated in this API page; related Pay by Link sources conflict on BNPL channel support.
Tokenization requires consent and model-specific fields; examples do not prove stored credentials or later payments.
